[Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T11:32:47Z, by staff] Curbline Properties Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Raises 2026 Outlook
Curbline Properties announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting revenue of $71.1 million and operating FFO of $0.32 per share, while raising its full-year 2026 operating FFO outlook.
Curbline Properties reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $71.1 million, exceeding the FactSet consensus estimate of $66.5 million. The company posted operating FFO of $0.32 per share, which was in line with analyst expectations. Additionally, the company raised its full-year 2026 operating FFO per share guidance to a range of $1.25 to $1.27. These results reflect the company's performance as a self-managed REIT focused on convenience shopping centers.

[Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T11:32:15Z, by staff] Ryder System Reports Q3 2026 Earnings and Raises Full-Year Guidance
Ryder System, Inc. reported an increase in third-quarter comparable earnings and revenue, leading the company to raise its 2026 comparable earnings guidance.
Ryder System, Inc. announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, highlighting growth in both comparable earnings and revenue. Following these results, the company increased its full-year 2026 comparable earnings guidance. The reported adjusted earnings per share of $4.33 exceeded the FactSet consensus estimate of $4.15. Additionally, the company's updated non-GAAP earnings per share guidance range of $14.85 to $15.05 is above the previously expected FactSet estimate of $14.67.

[Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T11:32:15Z, by staff] Honeywell Technologies Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full-Year Outlook
Honeywell Technologies announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results and increased its full-year sales guidance, citing strong performance in its first quarter as an independent company.
Honeywell Technologies reported its third-quarter 2026 financial results and raised its full-year sales outlook to a range of $20.0 billion to $20.1 billion. This updated guidance represents an increase from the company's previous expectation of $19.8 billion to $20.0 billion. The company projects organic sales growth of 4 percent to 5 percent for the full year, with an anticipated 5 percent to 6 percent organic growth in the fourth quarter. CEO Vimal Kapur attributed the positive results to strong performance during the company's first quarter operating as a standalone entity following its spin-off.
